citations.title: Modelling the Orvan gap: assumptions matter more than the headline
citations.excerpt: The assumptions are doing most of the work in this model, and readers should test them rather than accept the headline. A small change in the rail limit moves the net figure by several points, because the rail base is small but the gain is large in percentage terms. The Vanir assumption matters less for the total, though it matters a lot for Tolan and Midgard wheat. We have not modelled a full recovery of the sea route inside the window, because the port index does not support one. The model is a guide to the size of the gap, not a forecast of monthly prices.
